name: Ultimate Broker Route (UBR)
description: A mobile-first lead routing app that tracks door-to-door activity, route metrics, and follow-ups like a game scoreboard.
content: UBR helps field agents plan multi-day routes, track “stop outcomes,” and reset daily activity for performance coaching. Built for insurance/Medicare/solar door-knockers and similar field sales roles. Key Features: Multi-select stop outcomes, Daily auto-reset, Archive & route status tracking, OCR-friendly structure for future upgrades.
